<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Reorder request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order" messageRef="Message_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if first product is in stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_Stock_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForArrival" name="Wait for product arrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Delay" name="More than 10 days waiting" attachedToRef="Task_WaitForArrival" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Delay">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Penalty_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Penalty" name="Penalty demanded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Penalty_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_StockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue after product handling">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_StockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReady_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReady_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Arrange shipment and pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Withdraw" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">firstProductInStock = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct" sourceRef="Task_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Delay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_End" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="EndEvent_Penalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_ParallelSplit" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wholeOrderReady = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderSystem" name="Automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_OrderSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDelay" name="Was the wait more than 10 days?" default="Flow_Delay_NoPenalty">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_Penalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_NoPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_OrderSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Reorder request"/>

    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_Stock_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrival" name="Product arrives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDelay" name="Wait more than 10 days?" default="Flow_Delay_NoPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_Penalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_NoPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_Penalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Continue after delay check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_NoPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_ProductMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Continue after product handling">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_ProductMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProductMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProductMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNext_ItemMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Request courier and pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_ItemMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ItemMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_ItemMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ItemMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemMerge_CheckStock" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Withdraw" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">firstProductInStock = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Event_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrival" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_Penalty" name="More than 10 days" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDelay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">waitingTime > 10 days</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_NoPenalty" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDelay" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wholeOrderReady = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderSystem" name="Automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_OrderSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Reorder request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StorageManagement" name="Order processing begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order" messageRef="Message_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckMerge" name="Select product to check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectNext_CheckMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckMerge_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if product is in stock">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_Stock_Reorder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Reorder</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Withdraw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrival" name="Product arrives">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDelay" name="Was the wait more than 10 days?" default="Flow_Delay_NoPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_Penalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_NoPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_Penalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Continue after delay check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_NoPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_StockMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue after product handling">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_StockMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReady_SelectNext</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNext_CheckMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Request courier and pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_RequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CheckMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_CheckMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckMerge_CheckStock" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Withdraw" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">firstProductInStock = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Event_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_CheckDelay" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrival" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_Penalty" name="More than 10 days" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDelay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">waitingTime > 10 days</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_NoPenalty" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDelay" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMerge_RegisterProduct" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_OrderGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_ShipmentSplit" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wholeOrderReady = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady_SelectNext" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderSystem" name="Automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_OrderSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>

rules.instruction: When the description makes a follow-up action depend on whether a stated duration threshold was exceeded during a wait, and the wait completes before the continuing work proceeds: Model an exclusive decision after the wait, route the threshold-dependent action on its conditional branch, and merge that branch with the continuing route before later work. Do not represent the condition solely as a boundary event on the waiting activity.
rules.situation: the description makes a follow-up action depend on whether a stated duration threshold was exceeded during a wait, and the wait completes before the continuing work proceeds

rules.instruction: When the description states an occurrence that starts the process: Label the start event with a concise phrase naming that trigger rather than a generic label.
rules.situation: the description names the process purpose but does not state a distinct occurrence that triggers it

rules.instruction: When the description says an initial item is checked, and when a completion condition is not met, another item is selected before the same check is repeated: Route the initial entry and the repeat path through a shared merge gateway before the repeated check, keeping the item-selection activity on the repeat path. Route the completed outcome to the subsequent work described.
rules.situation: the description says an initial item is checked, and when a completion condition is not met, another item is selected before the same check is repeated

rules.instruction: Use an intermediate catch event when flow waits for a trigger and an intermediate throw event when flow emits or raises a result.
rules.situation: the description states that the process must wait for an external event before it can continue

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, event, or decision using terminology that distinguishes its meaning or outcome
